name: Financial Response V 05
definition: The FinancialResponse message is sent by an issuer or an agent to an acquirer in response to a FinancialInitiation message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the management of the protocol.

TransactionCharacteristics.name: Transaction Characteristics
TransactionCharacteristics.definition: Contains the key data elements of the transaction.

Card.name: Card
Card.definition: Card or payment token performing the transaction.

AccountFrom.name: Account From
AccountFrom.definition: Identifies a customer account or a relationship to its account affected for debit, inquiries and the source of funding for transfers.

AccountTo.name: Account To
AccountTo.definition: Identifies a customer account or a relationship to its account affected for credits, inquiries and the destination account for funds transfers.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

ConversionDateTime.name: Conversion Date Time
ConversionDateTime.definition: Date and Time of currency conversion.

AdditionalAmount.name: Additional Amount
AdditionalAmount.definition: Amounts that are not part of the transaction amount and not included in reconciliation.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes applying to the good or item.

OriginalDataElements.name: Original Data Elements
OriginalDataElements.definition: Data elements contained in the original message.

Acceptor.name: Acceptor
Acceptor.definition: Card acceptor performing the card transaction.

Transactor.name: Transactor
Transactor.definition: Information related to the transactior who provides technical payment solutions for acceptor and originator to conduct transactions.

Terminal.name: Terminal
Terminal.definition: Payment terminal or ATM performing the transaction.

Context.name: Context
Context.definition: Contains or describes conditions and characteristics of the transaction.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Data related to an integrated circuit card application embedded in the payment card of the cardholder.

Payer.name: Payer
Payer.definition: The party providing source of funds.

Wallet.name: Wallet
Wallet.definition: Container for tenders used by the customer to perform the payment transaction.

Cardholder.name: Cardholder
Cardholder.definition: Cardholder performing the card payment transaction.

Verification.name: Verification
Verification.definition: Method and data intended to be used for this transaction in order to authenticate or verify  the cardholder or his card.

Risk.name: Risk
Risk.definition: Context of risk associated with the transaction.

SpecialProgrammeQualification.name: Special Programme Qualification
SpecialProgrammeQualification.definition: Data to qualify for incentive or other related programmes.

Instalment.name: Instalment
Instalment.definition: Data exclusively related to a card issuer financial loan of the payment transaction, or instalment.

RecurringPayment.name: Recurring Payment
RecurringPayment.definition: Detail information of the recurring payment.

AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Additional functions or services to be performed in conjunction with the transaction.

AccountBalance.name: Account Balance
AccountBalance.definition: Balance of the account involved in the card transaction.

FundsServices.name: Funds Services
FundsServices.definition: Financial services related to the account.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service
SettlementService.definition: Type of settlement service for specific services requiring settlement.

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee
AdditionalFee.definition: Fees not included in the transaction amount.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

Promotion.name: Promotion
Promotion.definition: Information about the promotion applied to the transaction.

Documentation.name: Documentation
Documentation.definition: Additional information related to the dispute.

ProcessingResult.name: Processing Result
ProcessingResult.definition: Outcome of the processing of the authorisation.

AddendumData.name: Addendum Data
AddendumData.definition: Component contains data structures applicable to certain industries that require specific data within transaction messages.

StrongCustomerAuthentication.name: Strong Customer Authentication
StrongCustomerAuthentication.definition: EU PSD2 Strong Consumer Authentication data.

ProtectedData.name: Protected Data
ProtectedData.definition: Contains protected data and the attributes used to protect the data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC
